items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Most of all those albums were of Duke Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Twenty years ago. And that was 1955. typical I found out. Of course in the Army I had a hard time. A lot of people didn't like my albums, my records. I carried a case of, I used to have a little metal case full of 78s.
Most of all those albums were of Duke Louis Armstrong. Ellington, I had some very, very close calls with some soldiers, some draftees. (They couldn't stand it so dirty) (VOICE FADES OUT).
